title: Cold rebuild: tests that catch bugs
summary: Write Pester tests for Get-OldLog that fail on broken copies of the module, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Pester: tests that catch real bugs* you wrote tests for `Get-OldLog` that failed when the module was broken.
Write them again from memory: the same checks (including the mutants), **no hints, no solution**. This check and

steps.prompt: Where does the `Import-Module` of the code under test go in a Pester 5 or 6 test file?
options: On the first line, outside any block
steps.explain: Loose code runs only during discovery. `BeforeAll` at the top of the file runs once before the tests.

steps.title: Tests for Get-OldLog, cold
prompt: Write at least three tests in `~/src/LogTools/tests/Get-OldLog.Tests.ps1` that pass on the real module and fail when
`Get-OldLog` returns the new files or ignores `-Days`.
From memory: no hints this time.
